$comment: Controller firmware manifest. A leg has no internet path: bundles reach this portal's API, land on a session controller over its uplink, and fan out to leg ClearCores over XBee at the next dock. Signed end to end; the leg verifies before it writes.

distribution.note: Nothing is pushed to a leg mid-session. A bundle is staged on the session controller and applied at the next dock, when the leg is stationary and unloaded.

stable.label: Stable
stable.description: Default for every fielded leg. Promoted after 30 days on beta with no field regressions.

beta.label: Beta
beta.description: Opt-in per facility. Requires a signed consent record; beta legs are excluded from walk-off sessions.

hold.label: Hold
hold.description: No bundles delivered. Set by EREKTOR engineering while a regression is under investigation.

notes: Corrects a levelling overshoot on centre modules at low ambient temperature.
Raises marginal XBee packet loss into NET-11 instead of retrying silently.
Drive servo current trend now accrues against the mechanical serial, so a swapped ClearCore no longer resets wear history.
Stages leg bundles for fan-out at dock rather than on claim.
Roster now shows both serials per leg; wear and warranty read from the mechanical serial.
Offline sessions reconcile against the central registry on uplink recovery.
Predictive gearbox-wear estimate exposed as DRV-21 lead time.
Applied at ERS only: the update re-runs axis calibration on first boot, which must not happen at a site.
CC-0 accepts no signed bundles and has no remote path. Final maintenance release, applied by cable during an ERS visit.
